cards.title: When Your Teen Mirrors Your Worst Traits
cards.body: A parent discovers karma when their sullen, moody teen son mirrors the difficult adolescent behavior they once displayed. The article explores how to handle parenting challenges when you recognize yourself in your child's worst moments.

cards.title: Teaching Children to Reject Misogyny Early
cards.body: Misogyny is learned behavior, but it can be unlearned through intentional parenting. Parents can raise children who embrace equality, reject harmful comparisons, and build up others around them.

cards.title: Summer Co-Parenting: Managing Custody Stress
cards.body: Summertime brings unique challenges for co-parents navigating custody schedules and logistics. Practical tips help reduce anxiety and keep the focus on children's wellbeing during longer breaks.

cards.title: Understanding Seven Common Parent 'Needs'
cards.body: What parents identify as needs are usually strategies pointing to deeper emotional requirements. Understanding the root needs behind parental demands helps families communicate more effectively.

cards.title: Moving Past Regret to Build Understanding
cards.body: Fathers who move beyond silent regret and courageously revisit painful moments with their children create deeper understanding. Transforming shame into dialogue strengthens parent-child relationships.

cards.title: Teaching Kindness and Belonging Through Acts
cards.body: Parents who teach children about mitzvah and kindness help them feel part of something bigger than themselves. These practices foster empathy and awareness of others' needs.

cards.title: Adult Children's Diagnoses: When Labels Get Stuck
cards.body: The diagnosis you fought hard to secure for your child may become a limiting label in adulthood. Understanding when to release attachment to diagnostic identities helps adult children move forward.

cards.title: Difficult Conversations: Repair Over Rupture
cards.body: How families handle conflict matters more than conflict itself. Teaching children and partners healthy communication skills prevents lasting relationship damage.
